top_signals.title: BOE Set to Hike Rates for First Time Three Years
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England looks ready to raise interest rates by a quarter point to 4%, its first hike in more than three years. Ana Andrade of Bloomberg Economics has a preview of the decision. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: China’s Copper Squeeze Deepens as Buyers Scramble For Metal
top_signals.summary: Copper buyers in China are scrambling for physical metal, with spot premiums soaring as supplies tighten sharply in the world’s biggest consumer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI ‘godfather’ takes aim at Altman, Musk and Zuckerberg over ‘dangerous’ tech dominance
top_signals.summary: The ‘godfather of AI’ has warned the UK’s growing dependence on a handful of American tech giants is “very dangerous”, taking aim at Silicon Valley’s most powerful executives and questioning whether they can be trusted to control the technology.
